# uptimekuma_notification_evolution (Resource)

Evolution API notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_evolution" "example" {
  name          = "Evolution WhatsApp Notification"
  api_url       = "https://api.evolution.example.com"
  instance_name = "myinstance"
  auth_token    = "your-evolution-api-token"
  recipient     = "+551198765432"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: auth_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change auth_token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_evolution" "write_only" {
  name = "Evolution with a write-only secret"

  api_url       = "https://evolution.example.com"
  instance_name = "uptime"
  recipient     = "5511999999999"

  auth_token_wo         = "your-evolution-api-key"
  auth_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_url` (String, Sensitive) Evolution API URL endpoint
- `instance_name` (String) Evolution API instance name
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `recipient` (String) Recipient phone number for WhatsApp messages

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Evolution API authentication token. Stored in state; use `auth_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `auth_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Evolution API authentication token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `auth_token`; requires `auth_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `auth_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `auth_token` until the next apply with `auth_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `auth_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `auth_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `auth_token_wo`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
